taxRevenue.means: all money the treasury takes in

revenueFromPeople.means: the population term of provincial tax

revenueFromFactories.means: the factory term of provincial tax

revenueFromColonies.means: tax taken from provinces of colonies

tradeIncomeWithTarget.means: trade income with the country named

interest.means: the daily debt * 0.0002 charged under Treasury

debtThresholds.means: how much debt is allowed before each penalty, default included

eyrieBatches.means: batches an eyrie raises side by side, added to the figure it computes from road, supply hub and rail, and capped at the same 3. Every batch is 12 dragons and takes 548 days, and nothing changes that

shipRepair.means: how fast a damaged ship is repaired

consumerShare.means: the share of civilian factories making consumer goods, before the ideology modifier

consumerSharePoints.means: percentage points taken off the consumer share

conversionDays.means: days to convert one factory between civilian and military. null is not allowed

resourceYield.means: what the named resources yield from their deposits, as a map of resource name to the change

targetYield.means: what the industry named as the target yields. On a resource that is its deposits, on `rail` the throughput of its lines, on `manufacturing` its factories.

revealsUnprospected.means: the share of the unprospected deposits of the resource named that becomes known, rolled between the two figures of `first` on the first survey of that resource and `again` on every later one

happinessPenalties.means: happiness taken from a province by the country’s own laws, policies and decrees. A national spirit may add to it, and may key it to the province under `scaling`

unrestAccumulates.means: whether unrest builds up at all

colonialUnrestPerDay.means: unrest added daily in every colonial province

unrestPerDay.means: unrest added daily. On a law, a policy or a decree it is charged in every province; on a national spirit it is the country's mean and is spread over the provinces, the way a spirit's happiness is.

ideologySupportPerDay.means: points of support added daily to the named ideologies in every province, taken from the rest in proportion to what they already hold. The value is a map of ideology to points, under Government, Ideological support

occupationEfficiency.means: what occupied ground yields to its occupier

manpower.means: the manpower pool. A conscription law sets it outright, as the share of the population of controlled provinces that can be called up. Every other source adds that fraction of the pool the law gives, so 0.1 on a spirit or an ideology is a tenth more men and not a tenth of the population.

populationGrowth.means: how fast the population of every province grows. The manpower pool is drawn from the population, so this reaches recruitment through it rather than beside it.

manpowerGrowth.means: how fast the manpower pool refills for reasons other than births: men returning from hospital, from reserved trades, from prison. Population growth is `populationGrowth`.

divisionLimit.means: the greatest number of divisions the polity may field at once. A polity with no source of it is uncapped

equipmentLosses.means: the action costs equipment from the stockpile

supplyUse.means: supply a division draws a day, against what its ground can pass

politicalPowerPerDay.means: political power a day, added to the base 2

enchantmentEffect.means: what a runecraft enchantment does, under Resources, Tazkuri

lawAdoptionCost.means: the political power a law costs to adopt, drift multiplier included. A flat figure applies to every category; a map of category name to the change applies only to the categories named

decreeCost.means: the political power a named decree costs to enact, as a map of decree name to the change, on top of the weighting its own compass earns

policyCost.means: the political power starting a policy costs

policyUpkeep.means: the political power a policy costs every day it runs

commanderCost.means: the political power appointing a named commander to a group of units costs

ministerCost.means: the political power an appointment to a government or military post costs. Their daily salary is money and is not touched

lawCeiling.means: the furthest a law category may be raised, as a map of category to the name of the highest option allowed. A country holding a higher one keeps it and cannot return to it.

driftMultiplierTowardTarget.means: multiplies the drift multiplier for moving toward the ideology named, under Government, Going against the ideology

tradeIncome.means: what a country earns from trade routes crossing its ground: coal, water, provisions, warehousing and repairs bought where the traffic stops. It follows how much crosses and is not a rate the country sets. The tariff is separate

conscriptionRaiseCost.means: the political power cost of raising the conscription law

doctrineCost.means: the political power a doctrine costs to adopt, as a map of branch name to the change

trainingTime.means: the time a unit spends in training before it is ready. A negative figure shortens it

organisation.means: the organisation a division holds, 0 to 100. A battle drains it before men are lost and a division at 0 withdraws

againstFortification.means: the defender's fortification effect, as the attacker sees it

againstEnemySupply.means: supply delivered to the enemy, as it reaches a province you can fly over

nightPenalty.means: the night penalty a division takes on attack and movement, under Night in plans 14

movementInTerrain.means: how fast divisions move over one kind of ground, as a map of terrain to the change, on top of the general movement figure

landCombat.means: land combat, attack and defence together

claimProgress.means: progresses a claim on a province of the country named

airDragonCombat.means: combat by dragon squadrons, the dragons of the air force rather than those in land divisions

groundAttack.means: attacks on ground units from the air

industryDamage.means: damage done to industry from the air

airBaseDamage.means: damage done to air bases from the air

airBaseRecovery.means: how fast a damaged air base is repaired

capitalShipCombat.means: battleship, battlecruiser and heavy cruiser combat

surplusOffered.means: the share of a surplus put on the automatic market. A trade law sets it outright; every other source adds that fraction of what the law gives, so -0.1 on a spirit is a tenth less on the market and not a tenth of the surplus.

deficitFilled.means: the share of a deficit the market may fill

tariffCeiling.means: the highest tariff the polity may charge a foreign flag. A trade law sets one figure for everything; anything else may instead give a map of product class to ceiling, and a class the map does not name keeps the law's figure. The classes are resources, equipment and consumerGoods, under Tariffs

relationsWithHolders.means: relations with every country holding the ideology named

relationsWithColonies.means: relations with every colony the polity holds

cannotMilitaryAlly.means: the polity cannot enter a military alliance while this is held. An economic or a technological one is open to it, as is being guaranteed, traded with and declared upon.
cannotMilitaryAlly.shown: may not join a military alliance

cannotGrantAccess.means: no foreign division may cross the polity or draw supply through it while this is held

cannotIntervene.means: the polity may send neither volunteers nor an expeditionary force while this is held

militaryAllianceTension.means: the world tension the polity requires before it may enter a military alliance. It may enter an economic or a technological one at any tension
militaryAllianceTension.shown: POINTS world tension needed to ally

guaranteedBy.means: the polity under `polity` guarantees the holder without the guarantee being bought, entering any war declared on it and paying what refusing a guarantee costs if it does not. It stands only while the holder's form of government is one of those listed in `whileForm`, and lapses the moment it is not, returning when the form does. With `whileIndependent` it also stands only while the holder answers to no suzerain, since a puppet's independence is its suzerain's to answer for.

guarantees.means: the guarantor's half of a guarantee a spirit hands out: the holder guarantees every polity holding the spirit under `spirit`, on that spirit's own `guaranteedBy` terms. Where a spirit carries this, those guarantees stand only while the guarantor holds it, and lapse together if it is lost.

wearinessModifier.means: how fast war weariness builds. It multiplies baseWeariness, and every source is multiplied together with the polity's own wearinessModifier in polities-starting-values.json, so +0.25 is a war tiring the country a quarter faster

establishedChurch.means: the state church cannot be disestablished while this is held: Secularise the state is barred
